## Notes

Release 2018-02-06, Strange Loop Games, Early Access section still shown at access. Simulated ecosystem with thousands of plants and animals and dozens of species, cascading effects; meteor set to strike in thirty days; pollution poisons rivers and farms; programmable laws voted and enforced, elections set taxes; player stores, labor contracts, fiat or resource-backed currencies; skill points from varied food and larger homes; 30+ craft tables; single-player and online co-op.
